result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text-overlap problem in the “Popular right now” card and a minor clipped/truncated carousel item at the right edge.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar”, the delivery time and delivery-fee text overlap and render as garbled text like “25–3Drdalivery”, making the metadata unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Separate the time, delivery fee, and cuisine into distinct inline elements with proper spacing/ellipsis, or stack the fee badge so it cannot collide with the time text.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel card on the far right (“Trattoria Piccol…”) is clipped by the screen edge and its title is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel padding/peek amount is intentional and truncate titles cleanly with ellipsis rather than hard clipping at the viewport edge.
